dedupe_keys.name: observatoire de l habitat open data housing sale prices rents transactions and building land luxembourg

description: The Observatoire de l'Habitat, a service of Luxembourg's housing and spatial planning ministry run with the Luxembourg Institute of Socio-Economic Research (LISER), publishes housing market statistics as open data. The organisation page and its dataset list read on 2026-09-28 show twelve datasets: advertised sale prices and rents of dwellings nationally, by commune and by district of Luxembourg City; apartment sale prices from notarial deeds by commune, by surface class and as refined prices excluding annexes; the number of sales of apartments, houses and building plots; and the area of building land available for housing in 2016. Files are XLS, XLSX and PDF, updated quarterly or semiannually, most recently on 24 September 2026. Coverage is national. Access is free, and all datasets are released under CC0. Caveats: advertised prices differ from transaction prices, commune figures with few sales are suppressed or volatile, and the building land survey is from 2016. It supports replacement value and exposure estimates of the housing stock for hazard loss studies, and land availability for capacity planning. Related record: data-statec-luxembourg-census-2021-dwellings-by-commune-lustat-sdmx gives the dwelling counts that complement these prices.
